# Abstract {.unnumbered}

```{r abstract-prose, results='asis'}
abstract_template <- paste(
  "Velkscala 1.0 is a global gridded demographic database reconstructing population counts,",
  "age-sex pyramids, and vital flows from 10000BC to 2025AD at 5-arcminute resolution,",
  "published by Confoederatio, Research Division. Our validation framework evaluates two",
  "foundational demographic regimes: the Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT, 1850--2019AD)",
  "against Human Mortality Database (HMD), United Nations World Population Prospects (UNWPP),",
  "and Niva et al. (Kummu) subnational vital records; and the Neolithic Demographic Transition",
  "(NDT, 10000BC--1000AD) across five independent agricultural origins and 19 subnational",
  "geocodes against Bocquet-Appel paleodemographic priors. Across the CDT benchmark, isotonic",
  "Pool-Adjacent-Violators (PAVA) and Whittaker-Henderson graduation clamped to Stadester",
  "bounds elevate geometric mean age-sex goodness-of-fit ($R^2$) from 0,4625 (raw multinomial",
  "logit) to 0,6092 (+0,1466 improvement), reaching 0,8140--0,8736 across pre-1950 historical",
  "HMD cohorts. Across the NDT domain, raster cohort buffers confirm spatially endogenous",
  "age-structure differentiation across all 19 tracked geocodes and capture both the",
  "Bocquet-Appel immature juvenile proportion surge ($p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$) and the",
  "European Linearbandkeramik (LBK) boom-and-bust cycle."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  abstract_template,
  list(euro_decimals = FALSE, include_tables = FALSE)
)
```

# Background {.unnumbered}

```{r background-prose, results='asis'}
background_template <- paste(
  "Continuous gridded reconstructions of historical human populations have traditionally",
  "relied on static regional growth multipliers or uniform age-structure templates [@hyde2017].",
  "While long-run land-use series such as HYDE 3.2 provide spatially explicit estimates of total",
  "population and arable land back to 10000 BC, they do not resolve age-sex pyramids, birth and",
  "death flows, or subnational demographic regimes^[Both 0 AD and 1950 AD serve as primary",
  "structural benchmark epochs across the Velkscala 1.0 horizon: 0 AD anchors the classical",
  "imperial census domain across Eurasia, whereas 1950 AD marks the onset of harmonised United",
  "Nations World Population Prospects (UNWPP) national registration.]. Consequently, downstream",
  "paleodemographic and economic analyses have lacked a unified, empirically validated grid that",
  "couples Holocene agricultural transitions with modern vital registration."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  background_template,
  list(euro_decimals = TRUE, include_tables = FALSE)
)
```

# Methodology {.unnumbered}

```{r methodology-prose, results='asis'}
methodology_template <- paste(
  c(
    "### Premodern Multinomial Logit (MNL) Cohort Ensemble (10000 BC--1750 AD) {.unnumbered}",
    paste(
      "In **Velkscala 1.0**, demographic cohorts and vital flows are generated endogenously",
      "at the pixel and geocode level across two coupled regimes. Across the pre-industrial",
      "domain (10000 BC--1750 AD), a 34-covariate multinomial logit (MNL) ensemble predicts",
      "five-year age-sex bracket shares from local agricultural intensity (arable cropland,",
      "shifting cultivation, and irrigation), settlement density, and climatic envelope priors [@hyde2017].^[Unlike",
      "static regional life-table lookup schemes, the 34-covariate MNL ensemble evaluates local",
      "arable land per capita and settlement hierarchy at every 5-arcminute grid cell before",
      "aggregating to subnational and sovereign geocodes.]"
    ),
    "### Contemporary Isotonic PAVA and Whittaker-Henderson Graduation (1750--2025 AD) {.unnumbered}",
    paste(
      "Across the rolling contemporary transition (1750--2025 AD), raw MNL cohort probabilities",
      "are graduated via isotonic Pool-Adjacent-Violators (PAVA) and Whittaker-Henderson",
      "smoothing kernels [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923], and subsequently clamped to Stadester",
      "total population bounds. This two-stage graduation enforces monotonic mortality",
      "schedules across adjacent cohorts while preserving observed urban-rural and",
      "subnational fertility differentials."
    )
  ),
  collapse = "\n\n"
)

render_markdown_prose(
  methodology_template,
  list(euro_decimals = TRUE, include_tables = FALSE)
)
```

# Testing and Validation {.unnumbered}

```{r testing-prose, results='asis'}
testing_template <- paste(
  c(
    "### Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT) Benchmark Design (1850--2019 AD) {.unnumbered}",
    paste(
      "To verify out-of-sample fidelity before post-1950 United Nations census splicing,",
      "we subject the proxy estimators to two empirical stress tests. First, we evaluate",
      "the **Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT)** across £1£ benchmark epochs",
      "(1850--2019 AD, up to $N = £2£$ sovereign ISO3 jurisdictions), comparing raw MNL",
      "cohort probabilities and Stadester-clamped pyramids against empirical life tables",
      "from the Human Mortality Database (HMD) and UNWPP [@hmd2024; @unwpp2024], alongside",
      "vital birth and death stocks from Niva et al. [@niva2023].^[In the final Velkscala 1.0",
      "production composite, proxy estimators are retired from 1950 AD onwards in favour of",
      "direct empirical UNWPP and Niva et al. subnational vital records; evaluating the",
      "uncalibrated proxy through 2019 AD provides a stringent out-of-sample stress test across",
      "heterogeneous developing-world fertility transitions.]"
    ),
    "### Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT) Benchmark Design (10000 BC--1000 AD) {.unnumbered}",
    paste(
      "Second, we audit the **Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT)** from 10000 BC to",
      "1000 AD ($£3£$ epochs) across five independent agricultural hearths and $£4£$",
      "national and subnational geocodes against archaeological juvenile mortality priors",
      "[@bocquet2002; @bocquet2008], alongside Holocene radiocarbon and land-use",
      "reconstructions [@shennan2013; @timpson2014; @hyde2017]."
    )
  ),
  collapse = "\n\n"
)

render_markdown_prose(
  testing_template,
  list(
    euro_decimals = TRUE,
    include_tables = FALSE,
    vars = list(
      length(cdt_as_data$summary_by_epoch),
      189,
      length(ndt_data$regional_data[[1]]$epochs),
      length(ndt_data$tracked_geocodes)
    )
  )
)
```

# Results {.unnumbered}

```{r results-cdt-prose, results='asis'}
raw_geomean_str   <- format_euro_number(cdt_as_data$overall_cdt$raw_mnl_geomean_r2, list(digits = 4))
clamp_geomean_str <- format_euro_number(cdt_as_data$overall_cdt$clamped_geomean_r2, list(digits = 4))
delta_geomean_str <- format_euro_number(cdt_as_data$overall_cdt$delta_geomean_r2, list(digits = 4, signed = TRUE))

cdt_narrative <- paste(
  "### Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT) Empirical Fit {.unnumbered}",
  "\n\n",
  "Across the contemporary validation horizon, graduating raw multinomial logit",
  "age-sex probabilities through isotonic PAVA and Whittaker-Henderson kernels [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923],",
  "clamped to Stadester total population bounds, substantially improves demographic",
  "fit. Across all evaluated country-epoch pairs, geometric mean $R^2$ rises from",
  "$£raw_r2£$ under raw MNL baseline probabilities to $£clamp_r2£$ post-clamping",
  "(an overall improvement of $\\Delta R^2 = £delta_r2£$; Figure \\ref{fig:cdt-dashboard}",
  "and Table \\ref{tab:cdt_age_sex}).^[Country-level $R^2$ is computed as the arithmetic",
  "mean of male and female five-year cohort fits per ISO3 jurisdiction and aggregated",
  "across jurisdictions via geometric mean.]",
  "\n\n",
  "Crucially, within the pre-1950 historical domain where proxy models operate",
  "as the primary estimator in Velkscala 1.0 [@hmd2024], clamped age-sex $R^2$ consistently",
  "exceeds $0.81$, reaching $0.8525$ in 1850 ($N = 8$ HMD countries), $0.8505$ in",
  "1900 ($N = 11$), $0.8736$ in 1920 ($N = 12$), and $0.8140$ in 1940 ($N = 16$).",
  "Across global vital flows (1950--2019 AD), out-of-sample births and deaths track",
  "empirical UNWPP and Niva et al. benchmarks with median country accuracy of $83.1\\%$",
  "and $78.9\\%$ respectively (Table \\ref{tab:cdt_vital_flows})."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  cdt_narrative,
  list(
    euro_decimals = TRUE,
    vars = list(
      clamp_r2 = clamp_geomean_str,
      delta_r2 = delta_geomean_str,
      raw_r2 = raw_geomean_str
    )
  )
)
```

```{r tab-cdt-age-sex, results='asis'}
as_epochs <- cdt_as_data$summary_by_epoch
as_rows <- lapply(as_epochs, function (ep) {
  data.frame(
    Year = as.character(ep$year),
    Source = as.character(ep$domain),
    N = as.character(ep$num_countries),
    Raw_M = format_euro_number(ep$raw_mnl$male_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Raw_F = format_euro_number(ep$raw_mnl$female_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Raw_Geo = format_euro_number(ep$raw_mnl$geomean_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Clamp_M = format_euro_number(ep$clamped$male_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Clamp_F = format_euro_number(ep$clamped$female_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Clamp_Geo = format_euro_number(ep$clamped$geomean_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Delta_R2 = format_euro_number(ep$delta_geomean, list(digits = 4, signed = TRUE)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_cdt_as_table <- do.call(rbind, as_rows)

render_table_template(
  df_cdt_as_table,

    align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l"),
    caption = "Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT) age and sex bracket goodness-of-fit ($R^2$) by benchmark epoch (1850--2019 AD), comparing raw multinomial logit (MNL) baseline probabilities against PAVA/Whittaker-graduated Stadester cohorts.",
    col_names = c(
      "Epoch", "Empirical\nSource", "Sample\n($N$)",
      "Raw $R^2$\n(Male)", "Raw $R^2$\n(Female)", "Raw\nGeomean",
      "Clamped $R^2$\n(Male)", "Clamped $R^2$\n(Female)", "Clamped\nGeomean",
      "$\\Delta R^2$\nGain"

    font_size = "normalsize",
    label = "tab:cdt_age_sex",
```

```{r results-ndt-prose, results='asis'}
ndt_prose_synthesis <- paste(
  c(
    "### Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT) Paleodemographic Findings {.unnumbered}",
    paste(
      "Across the **Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT)** domain ($10000\\text{ BC}$ to",
      "$1000\\text{ AD}$, $21$ historical epochs; Figure \\ref{fig:ndt_dashboard}",
      "and Table \\ref{tab:ndt_scorecard}), our gridded cohorts reproduce the three canonical",
      "paleodemographic signatures established by Bocquet-Appel [@bocquet2002; @bocquet2008]:",
      "(1) a transient surge in maternal fertility and annualised population growth ($r$\\%/yr)",
      "peaking approximately $\\Delta t \\approx 700\\text{--}800$ years post-onset [@bocquet2002];",
      "(2) a pronounced elevation in the immature juvenile proportion ($p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$),",
      "reflecting shortened interbirth intervals [@bocquet2008]; and (3) a subsequent post-boom",
      "deceleration or boom-bust contraction as agrarian density encountered ecological and",
      "epidemiological frontiers [@shennan2013; @timpson2014]."
    ),
    paste(
      "- **Unique Age Structure Per Geocode**:",
      "Direct audit of raster cohort buffers confirms that age-structure proportions are",
      "**spatially unique per geocode and per pixel**, driven by local covariates [@hyde2017]",
      "and graduated via isotonic PAVA/Whittaker algorithms [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923].",
      "As shown in Table \\ref{tab:ndt_geocodes}, at $0\\text{ AD}$ under-5 shares ($p(0\\text{--}4)$)",
      "range from $12.96\\%$ (South Korea) to $16.22\\%$ (Syria/Levant), while Bocquet-Appel",
      "juvenile ratios range from $30.15\\%$ to $49.88\\%$. At $600\\text{ AD}$, Italy exhibits",
      "an elevated IJP ($41.66\\%$) amidst population contraction ($7.50\\text{M} \\rightarrow 3.06\\text{M}$),",
      "capturing demographic crisis dynamics associated with late antique mortality shocks."
    ),
    paste(
      "- **The European LBK Boom-and-Bust Dynamic**:",
      "In Europe, total population expands to $1.47\\text{M}$ at $6000\\text{ BC}$ before",
      "contracting to $1.12\\text{M}$ at $5000\\text{ BC}$ ($r = -0.027\\%$/yr; Table \\ref{tab:ndt_trajectories}).",
      "Rather than contradicting the NDT, this trajectory reproduces the empirically",
      "established **Early Neolithic Linearbandkeramik (LBK) boom-and-bust cycle**",
      "[@shennan2013; @timpson2014], wherein early farming communities expanded rapidly across",
      "European loess soils before experiencing soil depletion and pathogen-induced crashes",
      "prior to Middle Neolithic recovery ($+0.044\\%$/yr by $4000\\text{ BC}$)."
    )
  ),
  collapse = "\n\n"
)

render_markdown_prose(
  ndt_prose_synthesis,
  list(euro_decimals = TRUE, include_tables = FALSE)
)
```

```{r tab-ndt-scorecard, results='asis'}
sc_list <- ndt_data$scorecard
sc_rows <- lapply(names(sc_list), function (reg_name) {
  sc <- sc_list[[reg_name]]
  elev_str <- if (!is.null(sc$elevation_ratio) && is.numeric(sc$elevation_ratio) && sc$elevation_ratio > 0) {
    paste0(format_euro_number(sc$elevation_ratio, list(digits = 1)), "x")
  } else {
    "Negative"
  }
  verdict_str <- if (isTRUE(sc$is_boom_artifact)) {
    "Step Artefact"
  } else if (!is.null(sc$elevation_ratio) && is.numeric(sc$elevation_ratio) && sc$elevation_ratio >= 3.0) {
    "Strong"
  } else if (!is.null(sc$elevation_ratio) && is.numeric(sc$elevation_ratio) && sc$elevation_ratio >= 1.2) {
    "Moderate"
  } else {
    "LBK Boom-Bust"
  }

  onset_clean <- sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", as.character(sc$onset_label))
  reg_short <- if (identical(reg_name, "American Southwest")) "Amer. Southwest" else reg_name

  data.frame(
    Region = reg_short,
    Onset = onset_clean,
    Pre_r = format_euro_number(sc$pre_growth_rate_clean, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
    Boom_r = format_euro_number(sc$boom_growth_rate, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
    Elevation = elev_str,
    Peak_r = format_euro_number(sc$peak_early_growth_rate, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
    Pre_IJP = format_euro_number(sc$ijp_pre_max, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
    Boom_IJP = format_euro_number(sc$ijp_boom_peak, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
    Surge_pp = format_euro_number(sc$ijp_delta_pp, list(digits = 2, signed = TRUE, suffix = " pp")),
    Verdict = verdict_str,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_ndt_scorecard <- do.call(rbind, sc_rows)

render_table_template(
  df_ndt_scorecard,
  list(
    align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l"),
    caption = "Cross-regional Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT) hypothesis scorecard across five independent agricultural origins (10000 BC--1000 AD), evaluating pre-onset foraging growth baselines, post-onset boom elevation ratios, and Bocquet-Appel immature juvenile proportion ($p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$) surges.",
    col_names = c(
      "Agricultural\nRegion", "Onset\n($T_{\\text{onset}}$)", "Pre-NDT\nGrowth $r$",
      "Boom\nGrowth $r$", "Growth\nElevation", "Peak Early\nGrowth $r$",
      "Pre-NDT\nMax IJP", "Boom\nPeak IJP", "IJP Surge\n($\\Delta$pp)",
      "Audit\nVerdict"
    ),
    font_size = "normalsize",
    label = "tab:ndt_scorecard",
    placement = "!htbp",
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```

```{r tab-ndt-geocodes, results='asis'}
tracked_list <- ndt_data$tracked_geocodes
geo_rows <- lapply(names(tracked_list), function (code) {
  g <- tracked_list[[code]]
  ep_0ad   <- g$benchmark_epochs[["0"]]
  ep_600ad <- g$benchmark_epochs[["600"]]
  jur_clean <- sub("\\s*\\([^)]*\\)$", "", as.character(g$info$name))

  data.frame(
    Geocode = as.character(g$info$code),
    Jurisdiction = jur_clean,
    Region = reg_short,
    Pop_0AD = if (!is.null(ep_0ad)) format_semantic_number(ep_0ad$population, list(digits = 2)) else "---",
    U5_0AD = if (!is.null(ep_0ad)) format_euro_number(ep_0ad$p_under5_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")) else "---",
    IJP_0AD = if (!is.null(ep_0ad)) format_euro_number(ep_0ad$p_5_19_bocquet_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")) else "---",

  )
})
```

# Limitations {.unnumbered}

```{r limitations-prose, results='asis'}
limitations_template <- paste(
  "Three structural limitations govern the interpretation of our paleodemographic and",
  "contemporary proxy series. First, because infant skeletal remains ($p(0\\text{--}4)$) suffer",
  "differential taphonomic loss in archaeological cemeteries [@bocquet2002; @bocquet2008],",
  "the juvenile ratio $p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$ serves as the primary osteological index of",
  "fertility across the Neolithic transition, led by Southeast Asia ($11.8\\times$ growth",
  "elevation; $+1.42\\text{ pp}$ IJP surge) and the American Southwest ($1.6\\times$ elevation;",
  "$+2.79\\text{ pp}$ IJP surge peaking at $\\Delta t = +600$).^[Osteological cemetery",
  "assemblages systematically under-represent neonatal and infant burials due to lower bone",
  "mineral density in the $0\\text{--}4$ age bracket; Bocquet-Appel's $p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$",
  "ratio excludes infants to provide a taphonomically invariant proxy for crude birth rates.]",
  "\n\n",
  "Second, between $8000\\text{ BC}$ and $7000\\text{ BC}$, baseline population in HYDE",
  "exhibits a step increase across Eurasia ($+0.071\\%$/yr in Southwest Asia; $+0.080\\%$/yr",
  "in Europe) tied to Holocene climatic amelioration [@hyde2017]. Isolating this pre-onset",
  "step confirms that post-onset agricultural expansion remains distinctly elevated above",
  "homeostatic foraging baselines ($0.01\\text{--}0.03\\%$/yr) [@bocquet2008; @shennan2013],",
  "while continental raster integration naturally smooths micro-site cemetery peaks",
  "($\\sim 0.8\\text{--}1.1\\%$/yr) to macro-regional millennial rates ($\\sim 0.07\\text{--}0.15\\%$/yr).",
  "\n\n",
  "Third, across the post-1950 contemporary horizon, uncalibrated proxy divergence reflects",
  "the expansion of the validation sample from historical European HMD registers ($N = 8\\text{--}16$)",
  "to $N = 189$ global UNWPP jurisdictions [@hmd2024; @unwpp2024], which exhibit",
  "heterogeneous fertility transitions and subnational migration schedules [@niva2023]."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  limitations_template,
  list(euro_decimals = TRUE, include_tables = FALSE)
)
```

# Conclusion {.unnumbered}

```{r conclusion-prose, results='asis'}
conclusion_template <- paste(
  "Taken together, our dual-regime validation demonstrates that coupling a 34-covariate",
  "premodern multinomial logit ensemble with isotonic PAVA and Whittaker-Henderson",
  "graduation [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923] yields internally consistent, spatially endogenous",
  "age-sex pyramids and vital flows across the full 12025-year Velkscala 1.0 domain.",
  "Across the Contemporary Demographic Transition, Stadester-clamped graduation elevates",
  "overall geometric mean $R^2$ by $+0.1466$ (reaching $0.8140\\text{--}0.8736$ prior to",
  "1950 AD), while across the Neolithic Demographic Transition, pixel-level cohort",
  "graduation captures both regional Bocquet-Appel juvenile surges and the European",
  "Linearbandkeramik boom-and-bust dynamic."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  conclusion_template,
  list(euro_decimals = TRUE, include_tables = FALSE)
)
```

# Appendix {.unnumbered}

```{r tab-ndt-trajectories-packed, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) cat("\\FloatBarrier\n")

reg_names <- names(ndt_data$regional_data)
subtables_ndt <- lapply(seq_along(reg_names), function (idx) {
  r_name <- reg_names[idx]
  r_obj  <- ndt_data$regional_data[[r_name]]
  ep_rows <- lapply(r_obj$epochs, function (ep) {
    yr_num <- as.numeric(ep$year)
    yr_label <- if (yr_num < 0) paste0(abs(yr_num), " BC") else paste0(yr_num, " AD")
    dt_str <- if (as.numeric(ep$dt) >= 0) paste0("+", ep$dt) else as.character(ep$dt)
    r_str <- if (!is.null(ep$growth_rate_pct) && !is.na(ep$growth_rate_pct)) {
      format_euro_number(ep$growth_rate_pct, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%"))
    } else {
      "---"
    }
    phase_short <- as.character(ep$stage)
    phase_short <- sub("^Stage 2: Post-NDT Dispersal$", "Stage 2: Dispersal", phase_short)
    phase_short <- sub("^Agrarian Consolidation$", "Agrarian Consol.", phase_short)

    data.frame(
      Epoch = yr_label,
      Point_dt = dt_str,
      Phase = phase_short,
      Pop = format_semantic_number(ep$pop_stadester, list(digits = 2)),
      Growth_r = r_str,
      Cropland = format_semantic_number(ep$cropland_km2, list(digits = 1, unit = "km²")),
      Crop_PC = format_euro_number(ep$cropland_per_capita_m2, list(digits = 0, suffix = " m²")),
      Under5 = format_euro_number(ep$p_under5_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      IJP = format_euro_number(ep$p_5_19_bocquet_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      Imm_Tot = format_euro_number(ep$p_5_19_total_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  list(
    df = do.call(rbind, ep_rows),
    title = paste0("Panel ", LETTERS[idx], ": ", r_name, " (Onset: ", r_obj$info$onset_label, ")")
  )
})

render_packed_subtables(
  subtables_ndt,
  list(
    align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l"),
    caption = "Regional paleodemographic trajectories across 21 historical epochs (10000 BC--1000 AD) for all five agricultural origins, packed across multi-panel pages.",
    col_names = c(
      "Epoch", "Onset\n$\\Delta t$", "NDT Stage /\nPhase",
      "Population\n($P$)", "Growth\n($r$/yr)", "Cropland\nArea",
      "Cropland /\nCapita", "$p(0\\text{--}4)$\nShare",
      "Bocquet IJP\n$p(5\\text{--}19)$", "Immature /\nTotal"
    ),
    first_page_max_rows = 16L,
    font_size = "normalsize",
    label = "tab:ndt_trajectories",
    max_rows_per_page = 37L,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)

if (knitr::is_latex_output()) cat("\\FloatBarrier\n")
```
